title: Pelican Reckon
style: Aussie comedy pop-rap with playful dembow bounce and cheeky call-and-response, fast handclaps, stomped footwork, beatbox pockets, and gleaming gang hooks; verse trades between four singers, pre-chorus squeezes into a tighter chant, chorus lands big and bouncy with stacked harmonies, little Spanish licks, and bratty ad-lib doubles; ear candy includes bird squawks, reverse swells into the drop, and quick vocal flips; bright, punchy, and cartoon-clean with a sunburnt grin, comedy, oi
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey: Pink drink thinkin' in the esky glow,
Corey: Pink milk, mate, watch the weirdness grow.
Michelle: Oi, that's milk in a fancy frock,
Michelle: You call it a smoothie? Nah, that's a shock.

Ruby: Pelican pecked at the party tray,
Ruby: Stole a sausage and waddled away.
Wesley: My mini black sniffer, he got that nose,
Wesley: Found the snag stack before Mum knows.

[Pre-Chorus]
Corey: Aye i i, we tune in close,
Michelle: Hawk eye up, see the whole show.
Ruby: Quokka bounce, otter slide,
Wesley: Galah talk with a sideways pride.

[Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Aussie aussie aussie, loud and clear
Oi oi oi, we all appear
Pelican reckon, mate, that's dear

Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, come on near
Micha, Wezza, Bo Bo, cheer
Aussie aussie aussie, right here

[Verse 2]
Michelle: Corey got the Corey A I eye,
Michelle: Eye sees all like a pie in the sky.
Corey: Forward, backward, I'm flipping the scheme,
Corey: Reverse engineerin' my noodle machine.

Ruby: Magpie swooped by the barbie plate,
Ruby: Went for my chips at a breakneck rate.
Wesley: Magpies go for your eyes, hey, no joke,
Wesley: So I ducked like a crab and I nearly choked.

[Pre-Chorus]
Corey: Aye i i, don't blink, don't fuss,
Michelle: Spanish lick, hola, qué tal? that's us.
Ruby: Quokka bounce, otter slide,
Wesley: Galah grin, let the whole yard riot.

[Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Aussie aussie aussie, loud and clear
Oi oi oi, we all appear
Pelican reckon, mate, that's dear

Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, come on near
Micha, Wezza, Bo Bo, cheer
Aussie aussie aussie, right here

[Bridge]
Michelle: From the beach to the bins, we keep it strange,
Corey: Little bit cheeky, never outta range.
Ruby: Hola, amigo, pass that slice,
Wesley: Yeah nah, that's gold, that's sugar and spice.

[Final Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Aussie aussie aussie, loud and clear
Oi oi oi, we all appear
Pelican reckon, mate, that's dear

Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, come on near
Micha, Wezza, Bo Bo, cheer
Aussie aussie aussie, right here
